titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 31/79 (ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ އެކްސްޕޯޓް އިމްޕޯޓް ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Export Import Act (Act No. 31/79). It changes the import duty rates in tariff item 24, which covers tobacco products. It adds a duty of 200 percent for a new group of goods under tariff item 85 (electrical goods), which appears to cover electronic cigarettes and similar devices. It also rewrites Article 8 and sets a 30-day deadline in clause 6. The scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain. This summary covers the first 12 of 18 pages.
whyItMatters: Cigarettes, cigars and similar tobacco goods would cost more to import, and the higher duty would probably show up in shop prices.
keyProvisions: Clause 1 replaces Article 5(a)(1)(i) with a new text.

Clause 2 replaces the table for tariff item 24 in Article 7(a). The table lists a 200 percent duty for one group of goods and a duty of 50 percent or Rf 8 for four other categories, with the higher amount applying.
The bill's comparison table shows the current duty on those four categories as 25 percent or Rf 3, so the printed change is from 25 percent or Rf 3 to 50 percent or Rf 8.
Clause 3 deletes one row of tariff item 38. Clause 4 changes tariff item 85 so that a group of goods that appears to be electronic cigarettes and related products carries a 200 percent duty.
Clause 5 replaces Article 8 with sub-articles (a) to (h). These pages could not be read reliably.

Clause 6 sets a 30-day deadline after the law takes effect, and clause 7 sets a start date in 2024. A finance note on the next pages gives revenue estimates in millions of rufiyaa, including 1,058.7 for 2025.
whoIsAffected: Importers and sellers of tobacco products and electronic cigarettes, smokers, and the Customs authorities.
statedReasons: The explanatory note says the duty changes are submitted together with the amendment to the Tobacco Control Act (No. 15/2010), so that the two laws match.
